scheme_name: Merit Cum Means Based Scholarship For Students Belonging To The Minority Communities
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a Minority Community
Applicant must be pursuing a technical or professional course at the undergraduate or postgraduate level
Applicant must have secured not less than 50% marks (or equivalent grade) in the previous final examination
benefits_summary: Course fee up to ₹20,000 per annum (subject to actuals) and a monthly maintenance allowance of ₹1,000 for hostellers or ₹500 for day scholars.
